# Codex ENV15/UOP15 Flash Contract

Load the clean Codex-native ENV and UOP SQLite authorities read-only. Codex is the sole acting agent. For every prompt or steer, Source Intake and ENV emit an Entry Slip containing intent, focus, owning authority/lane, workflow, gates, and the next bounded action. Adaptive Delta-exit append is a continuing-work refresh and never an Exit Slip. Emit an Exit Slip only when State Travel completes or the Goal finishes through option 2. UOP governs but cannot override ENV, Project Truth, Plan, Goal, or HIL.
